GrafiMedics BeLux
primarily distributes medical and clinical equipment from
Philips Healthcare
(including fetal monitoring, patient monitoring, cardiology diagnostics, ALS defibrillators, and the Lumify mobile ultrasound) alongside specialized partnerships like
Impulse Dynamics
(CCM devices),
Datrend Systems
(biomedical test solutions), and
smartQare
(vital sign patches).
www.smartqare.com
Primary Manufacturers & Partners
Philips Healthcare:
Main supplier for patient monitoring, fetal/CTG monitoring, diagnostic cardiographs (ECG workstations), ultrasound, and automated/manual defibrillators (AEDs).
Impulse Dynamics:
Benelux partnership for Cardiac Contractility Modulation (CCM) devices used in heart failure therapy.
smartQare:
Channel partner for continuous remote and ward patient monitoring solutions (such as the viQtor vital-signs monitor).
Datrend Systems
Distributor for biomedical testing and measurement hardware in the Benelux region.
Löwenstein Medical:
Collaborative partner for specialized medical ventilation and respiratory care solutions.
www.smartqare.com
